topology: Real Data Agent /turn -> real MCP -> synthetic MySQL/Trino and ClickHouse; resulting answer SQL -> mock Ember HTTP BFF -> actual agent snapshot proxy -> actual clickhouse-api -> Couchbase. Snapshot contract suite repeated against both Couchbase and S3-compatible RustFS.

agent_questions.question: List employee codes and employee names for all accessible employees. Include all employee statuses. Sort by employee code. Show a table.
agent_questions.answer_sql: SELECT employee_code AS `Employee Code`, employee_name AS `Employee Name` FROM dbpcm_datawarehouse.employee ORDER BY employee_code
agent_questions.assistant_text: All accessible employees are listed below, across every employee status, sorted by employee code. This reflects the employee records you're authorized to access.

agent_questions.question: Using payroll only, what is the total earnings amount across all accessible payroll records? Use register_type EARN, include all employee statuses and all dates. Show the total in a table.
agent_questions.answer_sql: SELECT sum(amount) AS `Total Earnings Amount` FROM dbpcm_datawarehouse.payroll WHERE register_type = 'EARN'
agent_questions.assistant_text: Total earnings across all accessible payroll records (earnings-register rows, all employee statuses, all dates) is $1,036,800.00. This covers only the payroll register records you are authorized to access; it excludes in-progress earnings not yet finalized into payroll.

agent_questions.question: Join employee to payroll and show employee code, employee name and total earnings for every accessible employee with payroll earnings. Use register_type EARN, all dates and all employee statuses. Sort by employee code. Show a table.
agent_questions.answer_sql: SELECT e.employee_code AS `Employee Code`, e.employee_name AS `Employee Name`, sum(p.amount) AS `Total Earnings` FROM dbpcm_datawarehouse.employee e JOIN dbpcm_datawarehouse.payroll p ON e.employee_code = p.employee_code WHERE p.register_type = 'EARN' GROUP BY e.employee_code, e.employee_name ORDER BY e.employee_code LIMIT 24
agent_questions.assistant_text: Total payroll earnings per employee (earnings-register rows, all dates and statuses), sorted by employee code. 24 employees have recorded earnings; the list covers the employee records you're authorized to access. The displayed table is paginated — the remaining rows (E021–E024) are available on the next page.
